sentences.text: The genus Gordonibacter was described for a strictly anaerobic, Gram-positive, short-rod or coccobacillus-shaped strain isolated from the colon of a patient suffering from acute Crohn's disease.
By 16S ribosomal RNA gene analysis the founding strain formed a distinct lineage within the family Coriobacteriaceae.
In a three-week walnut dietary intervention, Gordonibacter was among the genera reported as significantly enriched after daily intake of walnuts.
